title: Paula C NDE 20949
content:
I was floating. I felt like I was floating very high, but I realized I was looking down at my mother standing over me in a bed. My mother was trying to wake me up, but I did not understand why. Everything was so peaceful floating there. I felt very safe and happy. Then everything went white, not exactly white, but colorless. When I was about seven years old, I dreamed that my Uncle Tony was carrying the crucifix on his back, like Jesus did. The next day my mother informed me that my uncle had been killed. I had later learned in life that my uncle was murdered. But I had always been in tune to my uncle. He would visit me at night. I informed my mother, and she would tell me I was dreaming. I insisted to my mother that my uncle would wake me up to ask me where my aunt had moved. And when Uncle Tony would wake me up, I was always at peace and not scared. I was in the hospital and floating above myself looking down at my mother, not knowing why she wanted me to wake me up when everything is so peaceful and wonderful. Then the brightness faded and I was looking down a tunnel toward a point of light. In this point of light was floating my Uncle Tony with a beautiful bouquet of flowers. I remember telling him how beautiful they were. He held them out to me as I floated toward my uncle. I held my arms out to him, and then I remember pain. Like being beaten. My mother told me the next day I went into kidney and liver failure and was near death. Then the doctor told my mother that I was talking to my uncle and that was a good sign. My mother told the doctor my uncle was dead, and the doctor told my mother to do whatever she had to get me out of that situation, or I would not come back. I remember not wanting to come back. It was so peaceful there I wanted to stay. My mother was insistent and I could not stay where I was although I wanted to.

arrival.other_being_detail: Uncle Tony appeared in a point of light, floating, holding a beautiful bouquet of flowers.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Mother was insistent; doctor warned she must get Paula out of the situation or she would not come back.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Kidney and liver failure (near death) while in the hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Colorless/white phase before the tunnel; pain on return described as 'like being beaten.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE and peaceful floating/whiteness occurred before perceiving a tunnel and point of light with Uncle Tony.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Mentions longstanding nocturnal visits/dreams involving deceased Uncle Tony prior to the hospital NDE.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Everything was so peaceful floating there. I felt very safe and happy.” / “Then the brightness faded and I was looking down a tunnel toward a point of light.” / “I remember not wanting to come back. It was so peaceful there I wanted to stay.”
